Report export failing.label: Check export date range
Report export failing.description: Check whether the export date range exceeds 90 days. Reports over 90 days cannot be downloaded directly and must be queued in the background.

Report export failing.label: Verify user export permission
Report export failing.description: Verify whether the user has the 'Billing & Reports Export' permission enabled in their portal role.

Report export failing.label: Confirm data exists for selected filters
Report export failing.description: Confirm that trips actually exist for the selected dates, branch, and shift filters before assuming the export failed.

Roster / booking not syncing.label: Check roster file format
Roster / booking not syncing.description: Check whether the uploaded roster file is in CSV format and contains all required column headers (Employee ID, Shift Code, and Pickup Location).

Roster / booking not syncing.label: Verify shift booking cutoff time
Roster / booking not syncing.description: Verify whether the booking request was submitted before the agreed cutoff window (usually 2 hours or 120 minutes before shift start).

Roster / booking not syncing.label: Check automatic sync connection
Roster / booking not syncing.description: Check whether the client's automated HR feed or SFTP connection succeeded or failed due to an expired token or server timeout.

Roster / booking not syncing.label: Confirm cab route and seat capacity
Roster / booking not syncing.description: Confirm whether an active cab route in that area had an open seat available for the unassigned employee.

Live tracking / GPS incorrect.label: Check driver GPS signal time
Live tracking / GPS incorrect.description: Check whether the driver's device transmitted GPS coordinates within the last 60 seconds. Older timestamps indicate loss of cellular connectivity or a closed app.

Live tracking / GPS incorrect.label: Verify phone location and battery settings
Live tracking / GPS incorrect.description: Verify whether the driver granted 'Always Allow' location permission and disabled aggressive battery-saver mode, which stops background GPS.

Live tracking / GPS incorrect.label: Confirm vehicle tracker vs phone GPS
Live tracking / GPS incorrect.description: Confirm whether the vehicle has an installed OBD-II hardware GPS tracker or depends entirely on the driver's mobile phone.

Live tracking / GPS incorrect.label: Check map and route service status
Live tracking / GPS incorrect.description: Check whether external map providers (like Google Maps) or live route corridor services are experiencing system delays or outages.

OTP / boarding issue.label: Check SMS delivery receipt
OTP / boarding issue.description: Check SMS gateway logs to verify whether the OTP message was delivered, delayed by the mobile operator, or blocked by Do-Not-Disturb (DND).

OTP / boarding issue.label: Verify employee phone number
OTP / boarding issue.description: Verify whether the employee's phone number is correctly formatted with the valid country code (+91) and free of extra spaces or missing digits.

OTP / boarding issue.label: Confirm emergency boarding code
OTP / boarding issue.description: Confirm whether the shift supervisor can generate a 4-digit manual boarding override code so the employee can board without delay.

Billing / invoice discrepancy.label: Verify contract pricing and rate card
Billing / invoice discrepancy.description: Verify the trip charge against the client's signed rate card to confirm whether billing is per kilometer, flat slab, or extra shift rate.

Billing / invoice discrepancy.label: Check toll and waiting time receipts
Billing / invoice discrepancy.description: Check Fastag toll deductions and driver waiting duration against GPS trip timestamps to ensure extra charges are accurate.

Cab delay / no-show complaint.label: Check cab dispatch time
Cab delay / no-show complaint.description: Check the automated dispatch timestamp to verify whether the cab was assigned with adequate buffer time to arrive before the scheduled pickup.

Cab delay / no-show complaint.label: Verify driver call and message logs
Cab delay / no-show complaint.description: Verify masked call logs to confirm whether the driver attempted to contact the employee upon arriving at the pickup location.

Login / access issue.label: Check company login system
Login / access issue.description: Check whether the client's company login system and account connection are working correctly.

Login / access issue.label: Check account lock and password
Login / access issue.description: Check whether the user's account is locked or needs a password reset.

Employee address / geocode change.label: Check address details and landmark
Employee address / geocode change.description: Check whether the employee provided a complete street address, apartment or building name, landmark, and valid 6-digit pin code.

Employee address / geocode change.label: Verify map pin on drivable road
Employee address / geocode change.description: Verify that the pickup GPS pin is placed on an accessible, drivable road rather than inside a locked gate, pedestrian walkway, or water body.

Employee address / geocode change.label: Confirm corporate travel zone
Employee address / geocode change.description: Confirm whether the updated pickup location is within the client's approved corporate travel zone and active fleet service boundaries.

Driver / vehicle compliance docs.label: Verify driver license and commercial permit
Driver / vehicle compliance docs.description: Verify whether the driver's commercial badge, driving license, and vehicle registration certificate (RC) are valid and not expired.

Driver / vehicle compliance docs.label: Check vehicle insurance and fitness
Driver / vehicle compliance docs.description: Check whether the vehicle's commercial insurance policy and annual fitness certificate are up to date in the fleet portal.

Driver / vehicle compliance docs.label: Confirm police clearance and background check
Driver / vehicle compliance docs.description: Confirm whether the driver's background verification (BGV) and police clearance documentation are approved.

How-to / feature request.label: Check help center and product guides
How-to / feature request.description: Check whether the user's question or workflow is already explained in the client help center or training documentation.

How-to / feature request.label: Verify feature access for client tier
How-to / feature request.description: Verify whether the requested feature is included in the client's active subscription tier (Enterprise vs Mid-market).

How-to / feature request.label: Confirm product feedback is recorded
How-to / feature request.description: Confirm that valid customer suggestions or feature requests are logged in the product operations backlog.

DEFAULT.label: Verify client account settings
DEFAULT.description: Verify that the client profile, active service contract, and account settings are configured correctly in the portal.

DEFAULT.label: Try to reproduce the issue
DEFAULT.description: Try to reproduce the problem in the support staging or test portal using the exact same steps reported by the client.

DEFAULT.label: Collect error details and screenshot
DEFAULT.description: Check that the exact timestamp, affected trip or user ID, and an error screenshot or log are gathered before escalating.

DEFAULT.label: Check for known outages and maintenance
DEFAULT.description: Check whether engineering has already posted an open incident, known issue, or scheduled maintenance window.
